full_name: Annette Gordon-Reed | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Law Carol K. Pforzheimer Professor at Radcliffe Harvard University
bio: Annette Gordon-Reed is the second appointee to the Carol K. Pforzheimer Professorship at the Radcliffe Institute, a professor of law at Harvard Law School, and a professor of history in the Faculty of Arts and Sciences at Harvard University.
